orb.alt: Crystal ball: Earth and Mercury both orbit the Sun. A line of sight from Earth through Mercury marks where Mercury appears against the stars; when Mercury laps Earth, that spot slides backward, which is retrograde motion.
orb.heading: Scrying orb: orbit view

oracle.whyNoReset: Pre-shadow, retrograde and post-shadow are one cycle, so your checklist carries through all three. It clears when the next pre-shadow begins.

disclaimer.short: Dates via Astronomy Engine; may differ from other almanacs by 1–2 days.
disclaimer.full: Dates are calculated with Astronomy Engine and may differ from other almanacs by 1–2 days.

cards: Clear skies. Send the emails, sign the contracts, start the new spell.
The messenger runs swift. Launch what you have been holding back.
A season for fresh starts. Write it down while the ink still flows.

checklist.title: Before the shadow falls
items: Start the thing you keep postponing
Book travel and confirm the dates
Back up your phone and laptop
Send the email you have been drafting

preshadow.label: Pre-shadow
preshadow.sub: Mercury is slowing over ground it will cross three times.

cards: The messenger slows. Back up your scrolls and confirm your travels.
Finish what is half-cast before the {stationRxDay}. Tie loose threads now.
Read the fine print twice. What you sign now, you will revisit.

checklist.title: Seal these before the {stationRxDay}
items: Back up your files and photos

retrograde.label: Retrograde
retrograde.sub: Mercury appears to walk backward through {sign}.

cards: The messenger walks backward. Revisit old spells. Do not cast new ones.
Old voices may return. Listen, but do not sign in blood.
Tech hexes are likely. Save often, restart gently, breathe.
Re-read, re-do, reconnect. The re- words are your allies.

checklist.title: Rituals for the reversal
items: Reconnect with someone from the past

postshadow.label: Post-shadow
postshadow.sub: Mercury is direct again, retracing its steps until {postShadowDate}.

cards: The messenger retraces his steps. Loose ends resurface to be tied.
Choices made in the reversal can now be made official, slowly.
Clear skies return {postShadowDate}. Launch then, not now.

checklist.title: Close the loop by {postShadowDate}
items: Fix what broke during the reversal
